lines.text: Every day at five, the cat came to the window.
lines.sub:
Every day at five,
the cat came to the window.

lines.text: And every day, the old man left a little bowl out.
lines.sub:
And every day,
the old man left a little bowl out.

lines.text: Spring. Summer. Autumn. They never said a word.
lines.sub:
Spring. Summer. Autumn.
They never said a word.

lines.text: Then one winter, the window stayed dark.
lines.sub:
Then one winter,
the window stayed dark.

lines.text: One evening, the light came back on.
lines.sub:
One evening,
the light came back on.

lines.text: This time, she opened the window all the way.
lines.sub:
This time,
she opened the window all the way.
